headline: From fabrication to AI, one team builds the whole system.
intro: Chrisentia delivers complete mechatronic systems powered by artificial intelligence, developed in-house and deployed into working environments across Sri Lanka.

cards.title: End-to-End Delivery
points: AI engine development and electronics integration

cards.title: Specialist Engineering
points: Engineers across mechatronics, data science and software
Every solution designed around its specific application
Deep customisation to fit existing lines and processes

cards.title: Built for Harsh Environments
points: Tolerant to water, pressure, heat and vibration
Validated under real industrial operating conditions

cards.title: Data That Drives Decisions
points: Live operational data on one centralised interface
History, trends and anomaly detection built in
Insights that feed back into control and maintenance

cards.title: Sustainable by Design
points: Less material waste through precise inspection and counting
Lower energy and water use through demand-matched operation
Measurable progress toward the UN Sustainable Development Goals

_comment_wide: A card with "wide": true spans the full row. "sdgs" adds the numbered goal chips to it.
_comment_sdgs: Each goal's "color" is its official UN SDG colour, shown as a stripe on the chip.
